title: Red Hat Security Advisory: gcc-toolset-15-gcc security update
description: Multiple security vulnerabilities have been identified in the gcc-toolset-15-gcc package, which contains GNU Compiler Collection version 15. These include integer wrap, out-of-bounds read/write, stack overflow, and out-of-bounds read issues in various parts of the libstdc++ library. Red Hat has issued a security advisory with updates to address these moderate-impact vulnerabilities for Red Hat Enterprise Linux 10 on multiple architectures.
